01 — CANTTELL: a sibling paragraph is a direct child of body, outside any landmark

This rule recursively walks the whole document looking for content outside any landmark, collapsing contiguous unplaced content into one occurrence per real gap (see the rule's implementation notes for the full algorithm and why direct-children- only was replaced). The PASS case (all content already inside a landmark) and the SPA-single-root-div / button / dialog / live-region / svg / skip-link exemption cases are covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file. Note this explanatory text is intentionally placed inside <main> so it does not itself become a second violation in this fixture.

Stray content that landed outside every landmark region.
